items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: She would have records of the blues, whoever was playing the blues she would have the blues singers. Bessie Smith, whatever.

ctx.x: I heard everything -- I heard all kinds of music. My mother would have records of Louie Armstrong and Nichols his band, she would have records of Red Nichols and his band. She would have records of the blues, whoever was playing the blues she would have the blues singers. Bessie Smith, whatever. She would have the classics, you know, records of concerts, classics. I was exposed to it all, you know.
